758:t_1:406.en:
$$セツコ$$
「I'm sorry, Chief. There are still some points I want to go over again, so could you give me one more day?」

758:t_1:408.en:
$$セツコ$$
「Understood. I promise to submit perfect data.」

758:t_1:409.en:
$$トビー$$
「With that approved, the $$バルゴラ$$ finally goes into official mass production, huh?」

758:t_1:410.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「Don't go feeling like we're done all on your own, $$トビー$$. Our mission is far from over.」

758:t_1:411.en:
$$トビー$$
「I know, I know. The road of $$ＧＳコンバット・アクション$$ is long, rough, and endless, right?」

758:t_1:412.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「That's right. ...You and I decided not to go back to our original world, and to keep $$グローリー・スター$$ going with $$セツコ$$, the three of us.」

758:t_1:413.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「Don't forget that resolve, $$トビー・ワトソン$$.」

758:t_1:414.en:
$$トビー$$
「Roger that, Chief. I've made up my mind, so no half-measures from me. I swear it on the name of '$$グローリー・スター$$'.」

758:t_1:416.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「I'm telling you now, that combat tactics research assignment won't be something we do all nice and proper at some base, either.」

758:t_1:418.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「It looks like our new posting will be Gate defense.」

758:t_1:419.en:
$$トビー$$
「The hyperdimensional world... so we're the guardians between parallel worlds, huh...!」

758:t_1:421.en:
$$デンゼル$$
「That's the spirit! Put some fight into it, $$グローリー・スター$$!」

758:t_1:423.en:
$$セツコ$$
(The hyperdimensional world, where the Gate has linked the parallel worlds... I'm sure I can meet everyone in $c again, too...)

758:t_1:424.en:
$$セツコ$$
(I will live in this new world. With the pride of $$グローリー・スター$$ in my heart, as one who has the right qualities...)

758:t_1:428.en:
$$アムロ$$
「...I see. So $$カミーユ$$ is going back to being a student...」

758:t_1:430.en:
$$アムロ$$
「What do you plan to study?」

758:t_1:431.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I'm going into engineering to become a mobile suit developer.」

758:t_1:432.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I see... Someday I might end up piloting a unit you designed.」

758:t_1:433.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Captain $$アムロ$$, you're going to stay in the military as you are, right?」

758:t_1:434.en:
$$アムロ$$
「From here on, humanity will walk forward on its own two feet. My role of protecting that first step is over.」

758:t_1:435.en:
$$アムロ$$
「So I'm stepping back from the front lines, and I plan to be a test pilot who puts my hobbies first.」

758:t_1:436.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「Then please test the units I build, too, Captain $$アムロ$$.」

758:t_1:437.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「A unit for the coming era of deep space... I intend to build that, after all.」

758:t_1:438.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Understood. I'm looking forward to its completion.」

758:t_1:439.en:
$$エマ$$
「$$ファ$$ and $$フォウ$$ are going to be students too, right?」

758:t_1:440.en:
$$ファ$$
「Yes... I plan to study to become a nurse.」

758:t_1:441.en:
$$フォウ$$
「I'd say I'm studying to find what I want to become and what I want to do.」

758:t_1:442.en:
$$エマ$$
「So $$カツ$$ is the only one who'll become a soldier.」

758:t_1:443.en:
$$カツ$$
「In my case, that's if Dad lets me.」

758:t_1:444.en:
$$アムロ$$
「As for $$ハヤト$$, $$ブライト$$ and I will talk to him on your behalf, too.」

758:t_1:445.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「$$カツ$$ wanted it himself, but if they keep going at this rate and send me to the military academy too, what am I going to do...」

758:t_1:446.en:
$$クェス$$
「Does Captain $$ブライト$$ want to make you a soldier?」

758:t_1:447.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「I don't know. We've never talked about that.」

758:t_1:448.en:
$$クェス$$
「Then you two should talk it over properly. You're father and son, after all.」

758:t_1:449.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「You're right. When we do, I'll tell him straight that I want to study botany.」

758:t_1:450.en:
$$リディ$$
「Captain $$アムロ$$... The $$ネオ・ジオン$$ policy broadcast is about to begin.」

758:t_1:451.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I see... Then let's watch it here.」

758:t_1:452.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「...I am $$ハマーン・カーン$$, representative of $$ネオ・ジオン$$. To all of you watching this broadcast, I will explain the direction we aim to take as the political party $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

758:t_1:453.en:
$$カツ$$
「That was unexpected. I thought Colonel $$シャア$$ would be the one to represent $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

758:t_1:454.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I hear the Colonel is going to be $$ハマーン$$'s aide. He says if he stepped out front, they'd never break free of the old $$ジオン$$...」

758:t_1:455.en:
$$クェス$$
「They say $$ギュネイ$$ is going to be his bodyguard. In the end, whatever he says, he really does like the Colonel, huh.」

758:t_1:456.en:
$$リディ$$
「Captain $$アムロ$$... The $$ネオ・ジオン$$ policy broadcast is about to begin.」

758:t_1:457.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I see... Then let's watch it here.」

758:t_1:458.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「...I am $$ハマーン・カーン$$, representative of $$ネオ・ジオン$$. To all of you watching this broadcast, I will explain the direction we aim to take as the political party $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

758:t_1:459.en:
$$カツ$$
「That was unexpected. I thought Colonel $$シャア$$ would be the one to represent $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

758:t_1:460.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I hear the Colonel is going to be $$ハマーン$$'s aide. He says if he stepped out front, they'd never break free of the old $$ジオン$$...」

758:t_1:461.en:
$$オットー$$
「I suppose things have settled where they belong...」

758:t_1:462.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「It would seem so. $$ネオ・ジオン$$ has given up its arms completely and become a political organization backed by the colonies.」

758:t_1:463.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「I wonder... I would say they still hold some military strength in reserve...」

758:t_1:464.en:
$$リディ$$
「Then all we have to do is aim for a society where they don't need to use it.」

758:t_1:465.en:
$$オットー$$
「You've become quite outspoken, Ensign $$リディ$$.」

758:t_1:466.en:
$$リディ$$
「$$クロノ$$ no longer exists. The world and each of us only need to decide our own future by our own will.」

758:t_1:467.en:
$$ナイジェル$$
「Good attitude. I'll whip you back into shape from scratch, so be ready.」

758:t_1:470.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Seems $$シャア$$ is on your mind.」

758:t_1:472.en:
$$ブライト$$
「If the times need that man, he'll surely return to center stage.」

758:t_1:474.en:
$$アムロ$$
「He won't live in a way that tarnishes what he gained in $c, either.」

758:t_1:475.en:
$$チェーン$$
「He's already settled things with you, Captain, so I don't think he'll do anything reckless, either.」

758:t_1:476.en:
$$ベルトーチカ$$
「That's right. The score $$アムロ$$ still has to settle is something else.」

758:t_1:477.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I'll take my time with that one.」

758:t_1:478.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「I don't think you can afford to, Captain.」

758:t_1:479.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Maybe... I may have to follow $$バナージ$$'s example and make my own intentions clear.」

758:t_1:480.en:
$$カミーユ$$
(Hang in there, $$バナージ$$. Everyone is rooting for you guys.)

758:t_1:484.en:
$$ハマーン$$
「...I am $$ハマーン・カーン$$, representative of $$ネオ・ジオン$$. To all of you watching this broadcast, I will explain the direction we aim to take as the political party $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

758:t_1:485.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「It feels kind of strange... To think that until recently, we were fighting side by side with that person.」

758:t_1:486.en:
$$ミコット$$
「If you're going to say that, everyone in $c is the same.」

758:t_1:487.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「True. ...But that's all in the past now.」

758:t_1:488.en:
$$タクヤ$$
「First I'll graduate from school. So I can think about what comes after that, too.」

758:t_1:489.en:
$$ミコット$$
「Let's all do our best, $$バナージ$$ and the others, too.」

758:t_1:491.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Thank you, $$オードリー$$... It was only a short time, but I was glad to see you.」
